description: This file defines the LeaveComment entity class for the OrangeHRM system, including properties like id, leave reference, creator, timestamp, and comment text. It employs Doctrine ORM annotations for mapping to the database and includes getter and setter methods for each property.

classes.name: LeaveComment
classes.description: Entity class representing a comment on a leave request within OrangeHRM, including properties for the comment text, creation timestamp, creator, and associated leave request.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave comment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the leave comment.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Gets the creation timestamp of the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Retrieves the User who created the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who created the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee who created the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee who created the comment.
